goal: Implement Slice S2 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (Initiative deepen-authority-seams): one function in runtime/workspace_scope.ts computes a TaskRecord's delivery identity; hosts and the CLI stop selecting the identity family. Pre-v4 records stay readable.

acceptance.assertion: Per D2 and invariants I3, I5 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (sources U1, E4): runtime/workspace_scope.ts exports one function that returns the delivery identity (diff_hash, changed_paths) for a root and a TaskRecord. Positive: a v4 record with git_base_head yields the revision-family identity and a pre-v4 record yields the index-family identity. Negative: a v4 record without git_base_head throws. Bound: projectAssurance and the Kernel application modules use this function when no provider is supplied, and a supplied diffProvider still overrides it. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-assurance-projection.test.ts, tests/kernel-canary-application.test.ts.

Per D2 and invariant I1 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: the Claude adapter, the Pi adapter and commands/kernel.ts obtain delivery identity from the shared function and no longer branch on record.contract to choose between taskRevisionIdentity and taskDiffIdentity. For the same v4 record and for the same pre-v4 record both hosts report the identity the shared function returns; a changed git_base_head changes it. Agreed seams: tests/review-revision-identity-conformance.test.ts, tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-work-extension.test.ts.

Per D2 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: batch plan reconfirmation delegates the computation to the shared function and keeps its refusal: a settled child that is not v4 or lacks git_base_head is refused, a v4 child reconfirms. Agreed seam: tests/batch-plan-reconfirmation.test.ts.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime sources and matches a fresh generate; no hand edit to the bundle. Agreed seam: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.
